thread:
Mina K.: Quick flag 1: zh->en eval BLEU regressed after yesterday's preprocess patch. Newsdev down ~3.8 pts.
Cheng Li: I saw token counts jump too. Avg source tokens +40% on a small shard. Looks like language-hint splitting between Han and Latin/numerics.
Mina K.: We turned on lang_detect in preprocess (commit 8f3a2b9) to catch translit, didn't expect this much fragmentation.
Samir P.: Can we get a small repro? even one line that shows the split.
Cheng Li: Example raw: `2025Q1 results: revenue $5M  see chart.`
Cheng Li: With lang_detect=true tokenized ->
```["2025","\u5e74","Q","1","results",":","revenue","$","5","M","\u2014","see","chart","."] (14)```
Cheng Li: Baseline (lang_detect=false) ->
```["2025\u5e74","Q1","results",":","revenue","$5M","\u2014","see","chart."] (9)```
Luca V.: So lang hint is forcing boundaries that make sentencepiece produce more subwords. That'll increase decode steps and likely hurt BLEU.
Mina K.: Mini stats: 2k zh-en pairs, avg src tokens baseline=56, langid=78. BLEU 32.1 -> 28.3 on that subset.
eval-bot: Regression alert: zh-en-newsdev tokens/source +39%, BLEU -3.8. Canary affected.
Samir P.: Plan: revert lang_detect on canary, behind feature-flag. I'll open PR to default=false and add telemetry.
Cheng Li: I'll bisect 8f3a2b9..8f3a2ff for the heuristic change and dump sentencepiece merges to see vocab interactions. Uploaded repro batch to s3: s3://redwood-evals/repro/langhint-bloat/2025-samples.gz
Mina K.: I'll run int8 quant smoke to check sensitivity to longer sequences; if token count increases, quant behavior might amplify quality loss.
Luca V.: I'll add token-per-source distribution + per-model BLEU delta to dashboards and add runbook note about language-hint side effects on CJK+Latin mixes.
Samir P.: Infra repro command: `./run_eval.sh --model=veridian-v2 --tokenizer=spm-v2 --preproc-langid=false --evalset=newsdev-zh-en --out=runA.json`
Mina K.: Assigning: Samir -> PR revert, Cheng -> bisect + minimal repro, Mina -> quant smoke + full eval diff, Luca -> dashboard + runbook.
Cheng Li: starting bisect now.
eval-bot: Reminder: if we flip canary settings, post in #eng-releases and annotate rollout reasoning"
